summary: The normalization, determinant identities, cap translations, nonempty cap cases, piecewise area calculations, rational comparisons, allocation identity, and final contradiction are otherwise correct and cover both determinant signs. However, the proof makes false or undefined universal assertions on the empty lower-cap and empty K_z strata, so it does not have zero mathematical errors as written.
critical_errors: The cap lemma (16) is false as stated for every threshold cell. If z<min_T f, then the upper-cap fraction is rho=1 and T intersect {f<=z} is empty. The claimed lower bound is zero, but the empty set contains no triangle of area zero or otherwise. Thus the assertion that the empty/full cases follow directly is incorrect, even though the later application has rho<1 and avoids this case.
gaps: The definition of m(z) as the maximum area of a triangle contained in K_z is undefined when z<-a, because K_z is empty and there are no contained triangles. Formula (17) assigns m(z)=0 on that stratum without stating an empty-set convention.
repair_hints: State and prove the cap lemma only for rho<1, which is the range actually used after (21)-(22), or explicitly adopt and define an appropriate generalized empty-simplex convention.
Define m(z) as zero by explicit convention on empty K_z, or restrict its definition and the subsequent implication to nonempty K_z.
